intro.data: Pair a thing with itself and you get a duplicator. The tray holds two machines; bring the Diagonal onto the board and wire the name to a pair of IDENTICAL copies — so both projections return the original. One makes a true twin; the other a mismatched pair. Leave the mismatch in the tray.
intro.alchemy: Pair a thing with itself and you get a duplicator. The tray holds two machines; bring the Diagonal onto the board and wire the salt to identical twins. One makes a true twin; the other a mismatch. Leave the mismatch in the tray.
intro.spellcraft: Pair a thing with itself and you get a duplicator. The tray holds two machines; bring the Diagonal onto the board and wire the light to identical twins. One is a true twin; the other a mismatch. Leave the mismatch in the tray.
intro.abstract: Δ copies a value into the pair (a,a), holding it twice; π₁/π₂ then both recover it. From the tray bring Δ and wire A to A×A, so 3 ↦ (3,3); leave the mismatch (3 ↦ (3,4)) in the tray.

goal.data: Bring the Diagonal from the tray and wire the name into an identical pair.
goal.alchemy: Bring the Diagonal from the tray and wire the salt into identical twins.
goal.spellcraft: Bring the Diagonal from the tray and wire the light into identical twins.
goal.abstract: Bring Δ from the tray and wire A to A×A as two equal copies.

description.abstract: not the diagonal: sends 3 ↦ (3,4) — the two copies differ

afterSuccess.data: The Diagonal made two identical copies, so projecting either side gives back the original — π₁∘Δ = π₂∘Δ = id. The mismatched pair would fail that. The product gives you faithful duplication for free.
afterSuccess.alchemy: The Diagonal made identical twins; either projection gives back the salt. The mismatch would fail. The product gives duplication for free.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: The Diagonal made identical twins; either projection gives back the light. The mismatch would fail. The product gives duplication for free.
afterSuccess.abstract: Δ = ⟨id, id⟩, so π₁∘Δ = π₂∘Δ = id. The mismatched pair is not the diagonal.

reveal.summary: The diagonal Δ : A → A×A pairs an object with itself; both projections recover the original: π₁∘Δ = π₂∘Δ = id_A.
reveal.moreFormal: The diagonal is the pairing of identity with itself — duplication, available in any category with products.
reveal.programmerAnalogy: const dup = (x) => [x, x]; both [0] and [1] return x.
